scenarios.description: Start includes upstream dependencies in order and stop rejects an unsafe database-first request.

expected.health: successful start is verified; unsafe MySQL stop does not execute

interfaces.api: plan and blocker use typed JSON
interfaces.ui: ordered steps and blocker are visible
interfaces.cli: plan matches API and blocked exit is stable
interfaces.telegram: status is observational and cannot bypass the blocker

expected.recovery: stop dependents explicitly before retrying MySQL stop
expected.rollback: no mutation occurs for the blocked stop

scenarios.description: An unhealthy MySQL dependency prevents SSC start and reports MySQL as the safe root cause.

expected.health: SSC is blocked by MySQL and post-operation health is not verified

interfaces.ui: MySQL is shown as root cause
interfaces.telegram: safe health detail names MySQL only

expected.recovery: restore and verify MySQL before submitting a new SSC start
expected.rollback: automatic database rollback is not claimed

scenarios.description: Cancellation is durable, checked cooperatively, and ends without abandoning the server-side record.

expected.health: completion health remains unverified after cancellation

interfaces.api: cancel returns durable cancelling or cancelled state
interfaces.cli: cancelled has a stable distinct exit

expected.recovery: inspect component health before submitting a new operation
expected.rollback: completed steps are not automatically reversed

scenarios.description: A bounded step timeout produces a distinct terminal state and sanitized progress.

expected.health: completion health remains unverified after timeout

interfaces.ui: timeout and recovery guidance are visible
interfaces.cli: timeout has a stable distinct exit
interfaces.telegram: safe timeout status does not advance authority

expected.recovery: inspect health and retry through the typed retry endpoint
expected.rollback: a timed-out adapter may have partially acted and is not auto-reversed

scenarios.description: Retry creates a new bounded operation linked to a failed or timed-out predecessor.

expected.health: post-operation checks are verified on the retry

interfaces.cli: retry uses the same API contract
interfaces.telegram: provider delivery is unrelated to retry execution

expected.recovery: the successful retry is the authoritative final operation
expected.rollback: retry is forward recovery rather than rollback

scenarios.description: Manager startup fences an incomplete operation as interrupted while preserving sanitized history.

expected.health: actual component state requires fresh inspection

interfaces.api: interrupted record remains readable after login
interfaces.ui: history survives and session is reauthenticated

expected.recovery: inspect health and submit a new typed operation
expected.rollback: manager restart does not imply workload rollback

scenarios.description: Overlapping affected components reject the second request without executing it.

interfaces.api: conflict code is stable and sanitized
interfaces.cli: conflict is a blocked automation outcome

expected.recovery: wait for the active operation and re-plan from current state
expected.rollback: the rejected request performs no mutation

scenarios.description: Expired or state-drifted approval cannot authorize a lifecycle request.

expected.health: no component mutation or health transition occurs

interfaces.ui: operator is prompted to refresh and re-plan

scenarios.description: Provider failure delays notification but cannot change operation or approval state.

expected.health: operation and component health remain unchanged

interfaces.ui: provider outage does not show success
interfaces.telegram: pending notification is delivered once after recovery

expected.recovery: retry bounded provider delivery without replaying authority
expected.rollback: communications delivery has no component rollback

scenarios.description: Wrong identity, expired, forged, or replayed opaque callbacks fail closed.

expected.health: no component mutation or health transition occurs

interfaces.telegram: generic denial reveals no callback internals

expected.recovery: authorized operator refreshes status and requests a new action

scenarios.description: A synthetic secret replacement exposes metadata only across every persisted and rendered surface.

expected.health: all affected consumers pass post-update verification

interfaces.api: response contains metadata and opaque revision only
interfaces.ui: input clears and stored value cannot be read
interfaces.telegram: high-risk replacement cannot be approved there

expected.recovery: targeted consumers can be inspected and a new replacement submitted
expected.rollback: adapter-owned prior revision may be restored; value is never returned

scenarios.description: Uninstall remains separate from persistent-data deletion and each exact high-risk plan needs local approval.

expected.health: uninstalled workload is absent while persistent data is unchanged

interfaces.api: destructive and deletesData are distinct booleans
interfaces.ui: exact target and high-risk warning precede confirmation
interfaces.cli: exact confirmation and approval identifier are required
interfaces.telegram: high-risk action escalates to local Web or CLI

expected.recovery: reinstall is a separate forward operation
expected.rollback: persistent data is preserved; uninstall rollback is not automatic

scenarios.description: A successful adapter mutation still fails the operation when an allowlisted completion check fails.

expected.health: completion health is failed and the operation cannot report success

interfaces.api: failed terminal state includes safe next action
interfaces.ui: mutation success is not presented as healthy completion
interfaces.telegram: failure notification links to sanitized health detail

expected.recovery: diagnose the allowlisted health check before retry
expected.rollback: workload or schema mutation is not automatically reversed
